title: Research
summary: Dynamics, detection, orbital analysis and the changing populations of the Solar System.
lead: My research spans the dynamics of Solar System objects and exoplanets, together with methods for extracting information from large astronomical datasets.

title: Minor Planet Center
summary: The community infrastructure behind small-body astronomy.
lead: I direct the Minor Planet Center, the international clearinghouse for astrometric observations and orbital information on the Solar System's small bodies.

items.title: The Minor Planet Center
items.text: The MPC receives, processes, and distributes positional measurements and orbital information for small Solar System bodies.
